name: d2-mcp-server
description: MCP stdio server wrapping the d2 CLI: render (with SVG dims), validate (structured errors), fmt, relationship extraction (text plane), markdown fence pipeline with dual-plane sidecars (relations v2: geometry-joined), layout/style variant bake-offs (slice-ranked), intent assertions (d2_assert), one-call visual gate (d2_visual_check), measured-geometry layout map, native-shape PowerPoint export + re-ingest (d2_pptx / d2_pptx_read), per-slide pptx-to-PNG rasterization for vision models (d2_pptx_render), layouts, themes, version.
